title: Baguette Tennis Necklace
descriptionHtml:
One line of colour at the base of the neck. A tennis necklace of rectangular baguettes set crosswise, side by side, each held at its corners by gold claws, closed with a box clasp. About 5mm wide, it sits close at the base of the neck. In deep Ruby, clear Crystal or Emerald.

STYLING TIP: Wear it close at the base of the neck with an open neckline, and add the matching bracelet.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 40cm
  • Stone: Rectangular baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise, the line approximately 5mm wide
  • Colours: Ruby, Crystal or Emerald
  • Setting: Each stone held at its corners by fine gold claws
  • Closure: Box clasp
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
